mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -16.3% (t-3w) to -11.6% (t-0w), a 4.7 percentage point improvement over four weeks. This sustained upward trend in retail mobility signals recovery momentum that will continue into the next four weeks, producing positive direction.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.7 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the last 28 days, or declines week-on-week in 3 of the next 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has recovered from -51.3% (t-3w) to -42.0% (t-0w), a 9.3 point improvement. Commuter return to transit stations drives weekday retail footfall. When TRANSIT improves by >5 points over a four-week window, RETAIL_REC follows with positive direction in the subsequent month.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose 9.3 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the baseline mean of the prior 28 days, or TRANSIT reverses by >3 points in week t+1.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 8% in any single week during the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines in 3 of the next 4 weeks.

failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT declines by >3 points in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is lower than prior 28 days.

The current negative PARKS value signals pent-up demand for indoor retail that will manifest as positive RETAIL_REC direction over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -5% in current week
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds above 5% in week t+1 and RETAIL_REC does not increase, or RETAIL_REC declines in both weeks t+1 and t+2.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has remained stable and positive (1.7% to 3.4%) across all four weeks, indicating essential retail access is maintained. This stability signals that restrictions on retail are not tightening. Under non-tightening policy regimes, RETAIL_REC recovers as consumer confidence stabilizes, producing positive direction over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains positive and stable (variance <2 points)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM ranged 1.7% to 3.4% with low volatility
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0% in any week during the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines below -15% in week t+2.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 8% or WORKPLACES falls below -20% in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not increase in weeks t+1 and t+2.
